zh.title: 聯合航空表示無意購買阿聯酋航空預製777X
zh.summary: Simple Flying報導，聯合航空對購買最多20架原屬阿聯酋航空的預製777X飛機「沒有興趣」，但為其他航空公司接手留下空間。此消息涉及777X機隊的潛在交易動態。
body: Simple Flying報導，聯合航空表示對購買原屬阿聯酋航空的預製777X飛機「沒有興趣」。
報導指出，相關飛機數量最多為20架，聯合航空已排除接收這些飛機的可能性，但為其他航空公司接手留下空間。
背景方面，777X計畫近期持續推進測試作業。根據本站資料庫紀錄，Boeing 777-9測試機隊已累計4,800測試小時，且美國聯邦航空管理局已批准777X計畫在Type Inspection Authorization 4B下展開認證飛行測試，首架交付預計在2027年。

en.title: United Airlines Says It Has "No Interest" in Ex-Emirates Pre-Built 777X Aircraft
en.summary: Simple Flying reports that United Airlines has stated it has "no interest" in purchasing up to 20 pre-built 777X aircraft originally destined for Emirates. The airline has ruled out taking possession of these aircraft but left room for other carriers to step in.
body: Simple Flying reports that United Airlines has stated it has "no interest" in purchasing pre-built 777X aircraft originally destined for Emirates.
The report indicates that up to 20 such aircraft are involved, and United has ruled out taking possession of them while leaving room for other airlines to step in.

In background, the 777X programme continues its testing progress. According to AVWIRE archive records, the Boeing 777-9 test fleet has reached 4,800 test hours, and the FAA has approved the 777X programme to begin certification flight testing under Type Inspection Authorization 4B, with first delivery anticipated in 2027.
